scope: internal V2 paired-contract acceptance verification; local Hardhat only
command: V2_ARTIFACTS=./artifacts-v2-runs50 V2_CACHE=./cache-v2-runs50 npx hardhat test --config hardhat.v2.config.js test/v2-pair-security.test.js

rows.title: constructor nonce pairing and wrong-pair rejection
rows.test: constructs only the nonce-paired vault/market and exposes no rebinding path

rows.title: blocked and false-return slash transfer rollback
rows.test: rolls back both ledgers when a real slash transfer is blocked or returns false

rows.title: deposit, stake withdrawal, escrow settlement and credit withdrawal atomicity
rows.test: rejects false-return deposit, escrow pull, and credit withdrawal atomically

rows.title: vault and market callback attempts fail under reentrancy guards
rows.test: blocks token callbacks before authorization and preserves both ledgers

rows.title: vault donation-only treasury sweep with blocked-recipient rollback
rows.test: sweeps only exact vault donations and cannot encroach on free or reserved stake

ledger_checks.successful_protocol_actions: pairLedger checked after each checked receipt
ledger_checks.expected_reverts: pairLedger checked before and after; full pair-ledger snapshot must be unchanged
ledger_checks.slash_pending_state: reserve amount, FaultReview disposition, and faultPending are explicitly read back after both failed slash variants

identity.checked: source SHA-256 identities and current paired build-info paths at suite start/end

remaining_gaps: This is not an independent audit and does not constitute external-chain or production acceptance.
The existing legacy V2 fixtures were not retrofitted by this change; their afterEach invariant coverage remains a separate verification gap.

Administrative/setup receipts (mint, approve, token flags, callback configuration, and time-control RPC calls) are harness preparation rather than protocol ledger transitions and are not each included in the checked-action receipt count.
